name: VolunTeen Student Summer Volunteer Program
org: The University of Kansas Health System
what_you_do: Volunteer for two weeks in a hospital. You see patient care areas and behind-the-scenes jobs and meet people who work there.
who_can_apply: Students going into 9th grade can join the rising freshman program. Students going into 10th, 11th or 12th grade can join the other program. The page does not list an age rule.
duration: Rising sophomore to senior: one 2-week session, Monday to Thursday. Rising freshman: half days on Friday mornings, at least 6 Fridays.
deadline_text: The 2026 application deadline was March 6, 2026. The program page does not list 2027 dates.
how_to_apply: Use the application link for your program on the program page. You must go to an in-person orientation. Email VolunteerApplications@KUMC.edu or call 913-588-6560.
notes: 2026 sessions ran June 1 to July 30. There is also a program page for the Olathe location.
